# infisical_cert_manager_internal_ca (Resource)

Create and manage internal certificate authorities (root or intermediate) in Certificate Manager. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host          = "https://app.infisical.com"
  client_id     = var.client_id
  client_secret = var.client_secret
}

resource "infisical_cert_manager_internal_ca" "root" {
  type          = "root"
  name          = "enterprise-root-ca"
  common_name   = "Enterprise Root Certificate Authority"
  organization  = "Acme Corp"
  ou            = "IT Security"
  country       = "US"
  province      = "California"
  locality      = "San Francisco"
  key_algorithm = "RSA_2048"
}

resource "infisical_cert_manager_internal_ca" "issuing" {
  type          = "intermediate"
  name          = "enterprise-issuing-ca"
  common_name   = "Enterprise Issuing Certificate Authority"
  organization  = "Acme Corp"
  ou            = "IT Security"
  country       = "US"
  province      = "California"
  locality      = "San Francisco"
  key_algorithm = "RSA_2048"
}

# The signing key is generated and kept in the HSM.
# Find the HSM Connector ID under Certificate Manager > Settings > HSM Connectors.
resource "infisical_cert_manager_internal_ca" "hsm_root" {
  type             = "root"
  name             = "hsm-root-ca"
  common_name      = "HSM Root Certificate Authority"
  organization     = "Acme Corp"
  key_algorithm    = "EC_secp384r1"
  key_source       = "hsm"
  hsm_connector_id = "<your-hsm-connector-id>"
}

# The signing key is generated in AWS KMS, and AWS KMS makes every signature.
resource "infisical_cert_manager_internal_ca" "aws_kms_root" {
  type              = "root"
  name              = "aws-kms-root-ca"
  common_name       = "AWS KMS Root Certificate Authority"
  organization      = "Acme Corp"
  key_algorithm     = "RSA_4096"
  key_source        = "aws-kms"
  app_connection_id = "<your-aws-app-connection-id>"
  region            = "us-east-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the CA
- `type` (String) The type of the CA. Supported values: root, intermediate

### Optional

- `app_connection_id` (String) The ID of the AWS App Connection used to create the CA's signing key in AWS KMS and to sign with it. Required when `key_source` is 'aws-kms', and only allowed then. Changing it replaces the CA.
- `common_name` (String) The common name (CN) of the CA certificate
- `country` (String) The country (C) of the CA certificate
- `hsm_connector_id` (String) The ID of the HSM Connector to generate and keep the CA's signing key in. Required when `key_source` is 'hsm', and only allowed then. Find it under Certificate Manager > Settings > HSM Connectors. Changing it replaces the CA.
- `key_algorithm` (String) The key algorithm for the CA. Supported values: RSA_2048, RSA_3072, RSA_4096, EC_prime256v1, EC_secp384r1, EC_secp521r1. Defaults to 'RSA_2048'.
- `key_source` (String) Where the CA's signing key is generated and kept. Supported values: infisical, hsm, aws-kms. When omitted, an existing CA keeps the key source it has in Infisical, and a CA that Terraform creates, including one it creates again (replaced, tainted or deleted outside Terraform), uses 'infisical'. Set it to keep the key of a re-created CA in the HSM or AWS KMS. 'infisical' keeps the key in Infisical. 'hsm' generates the key in the HSM reached through `hsm_connector_id`, and supports the key algorithms RSA_2048, RSA_4096, EC_prime256v1, EC_secp384r1. Infisical does not remove the key from the HSM when the CA is deleted. Requires Infisical v0.161.13 or later. 'aws-kms' generates the key in AWS KMS through `app_connection_id` in `region`, and AWS KMS makes every signature. When the CA is deleted, Infisical asks AWS KMS to schedule the key for deletion. Requires an Enterprise license and Infisical v0.166.9 or later. Changing it replaces the CA.
- `locality` (String) The locality (L) of the CA certificate
- `organization` (String) The organization (O) of the CA certificate
- `ou` (String) The organizational unit (OU) of the CA certificate
- `province` (String) The state/province (ST) of the CA certificate
- `region` (String) The AWS region to create the CA's signing key in, for example 'us-east-1'. Required when `key_source` is 'aws-kms', and only allowed then. Changing it replaces the CA.
- `status` (String) The status of the CA. Supported values: active, disabled. Defaults to 'active'.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the CA

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the internal CA by its ID
terraform import infisical_cert_manager_internal_ca.example <ca_id>
```
